Once your funds have exited the Trading Wallet and become available for withdrawal, you can send them to your external crypto wallet.

This is the second stage of the withdrawal process.

How long does it take?
External wallet withdrawals can take up to 24 hours to process.

Some withdrawals may be completed sooner, but processing time can vary.

It may depend on:
• blockchain network conditions
• transaction processing
• security checks
• AML and compliance checks
• additional verification when required

These procedures are part of protecting both users and the platform from unauthorized or suspicious transactions.

Remember the difference

Trading exit
Moves funds out of AI Trading.
↓
Available Balance
↓
External wallet withdrawal

Sends funds from METATRONICS to your crypto wallet.

So even if you choose the fastest trading exit, the external wallet transfer is still a separate transaction and may take up to 24 hours.

Fast trading exit ≠ instant external wallet withdrawal.
